# Each write of each act, refused one at a time on a fresh page. A block: the write and the
# answer; the requests that followed it; each run of text that appeared on the page (container,
# innermost element); the sheet; the page's message state; any rejection the page left unhandled.

## Save as recipe… on Style A
# writes, in order: POST /api/processes/1/presets
### POST /api/processes/1/presets  ←  400 {"error"} (writeError)
    then: nothing
    new text: #pd-scrim .mf .st (textContent): the Edge refused it
    notice: error "the Edge refused it"
    sheet: open "Save Style A as a recipe", status "the Edge refused it" (bad), OK "Save recipe" enabled
    state: no message set
    unhandled rejection: none
    pressed again: POST /api/processes/1/presets · GET /api/processes/1/presets → sheet: closed
### POST /api/processes/1/presets  ←  500, no body (chi Recoverer)
    then: nothing
    new text: #pd-scrim .mf .st (textContent): Server error (500)
    notice: error "Server error (500)"
    sheet: open "Save Style A as a recipe", status "Server error (500)" (bad), OK "Save recipe" enabled
    state: no message set
    unhandled rejection: none
    pressed again: POST /api/processes/1/presets · GET /api/processes/1/presets → sheet: closed
### POST /api/processes/1/presets  ←  no answer (fetch rejects: TypeError "Failed to fetch")
    then: nothing
    new text: #pd-scrim .mf .st (textContent): No answer from the server
    notice: error "No answer from the server"
    sheet: open "Save Style A as a recipe", status "No answer from the server" (bad), OK "Save recipe" enabled
    state: no message set
    unhandled rejection: none
    pressed again: POST /api/processes/1/presets · GET /api/processes/1/presets → sheet: closed
### POST /api/processes/1/presets  ←  session lapsed (303 to /login, 200 text/html, for it and every admin call after)
    then: nothing
    new text: #pd-scrim .mf .st (textContent): Signed out
    new text: .notice-root span.notice-text: Signed out
    new text: .notice-root a.notice-action: Sign in
    notice: error "Signed out" (sticky) · Sign in → /login?next=%2Fprocesses%3Fprocess%3D1
    sheet: open "Save Style A as a recipe", status "Signed out" (bad), OK "Save recipe" enabled
    state: no message set
    unhandled rejection: none
    pressed again: POST /api/processes/1/presets → sheet: open "Save Style A as a recipe", status "Signed out" (bad), OK "Save recipe" enabled
